Daily Devotional

February 8

11 Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content. 12 I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need. 13 I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me. (Philippians 4:11-13 KJV)

This is awesome, as Paul is telling us that we can learn to be content, as our contentment is not due to our circumstances, but is the way we look at them. We can teach ourselves to be content in all situations, regardless of our circumstances. We can train ourselves to be happy, and full of God’s joy, no matter what comes at us in this life, as it is all in how we think about it (Proverbs 23:7). If you toss your cares upon the Lord, as He has told us to do (Matthew 11:28), then there is no need to ever be unhappy or depressed no matter what happens to us. I think I will do just that!

If we die to ourselves, and let Christ live through us, then we can do all things, as there is no limit to the ability of God to work through us (Ephesians 3:19-20). If we let the Spirit in us lead us, then we should be able to overcome all problems that the devil, and this world, can throw at us (John 10:10). We are limited only by our small thinking, as if you are born again you have the very power of God living in your born again Spirit (Galatians 4:6), and you should be able to handle anything that Jesus could handle. If we could just realize the power that resides within us, we could lead the abundant life that God wants to provide for His children (Romans 8:18). Get in the Word of God, and find out what you have, so you can enjoy this life now. Thank you Jesus for all you have done for us who believe in you.
